title: No-tile window is 91 days; paging, sort and empty states
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in as a service advisor (view customers; edit customers to raise a work order), on the build under test. The Maintenance Reminders feature is on (behind the maintenance_reminders flag).
  2. Open Customers from the top navigation and switch to its "Maintenance reminders" tab. For the location cases use a two-workplace org (on a one-workplace org the location filter is absent).
  3. Enough enrolled assets to page (50+ rows); plus access to an org with nothing enrolled and an org with assets enrolled but nothing due soon.
  4. Enrolled assets with services falling due across the windows. Seed them: enrol several assets (asset Maintenance tab -> Enrol) and backdate last-service dates so services land Overdue, within 30 days, within 31-91 days, plus a meter-driven service with no readings (Needs readings). Include one asset with rows in two windows and one service overdue several cycles.
custom_steps:
1. With no tile active, read which rows appear and which are excluded.
  2. Count rows per page and read the default sort; sort by each sortable column header.
  3. Search by unit number, VIN, customer and service name.
  4. View the tab with nothing enrolled; with assets enrolled but nothing in the window; and with a filter active and nothing matching.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • With no tile active the list shows every row overdue, due today or due within the next 91 days, plus every Needs readings row whatever its date; a service further out is not listed.
  • The list shows 50 rows per page, sorted by due date oldest first then by unit; Asset, customer, service and due sort by their column header; search matches unit number, VIN, customer and service name and narrows the tiles.
  • Empty states: nothing enrolled -> "there are no maintenance reminders yet"; enrolled but nothing in window -> tiles read zero and the table says nothing is due in the next three months; a filter/search matching nothing -> "No reminders match" with Clear filters.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780; story SV-10570 (S13, The worklist); Chunk 1 MR spec (Confluence 886931488), S13; read 29 Sep 2026. Source-verified 29 September 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S13-R36: “With no tile active the list shows every row that is overdue, due today or due within the next 91 days, plus every Needs readings row whatever its date. A service further out is not listed”
  • S13-R37: “The list shows 50 rows per page, sorted by due date, oldest first, then by unit. Asset, customer, service and due are sortable by their column header. Search matches unit number, VIN, customer and service name, and narrows the tiles as the location filter does”
  • S13-R33: “Where nothing is enrolled, the tab says there are no maintenance reminders yet. Where assets are enrolled but nothing falls inside the list's window, the time tiles read zero and the table says nothing is due in the next three months. With a tile, filter or search active and nothing matching, the table reads No reminders match, with Clear filters”

AUTOMATION: HOLD - not yet build-verified on a Maintenance Reminders QA build (feature ships behind the maintenance_reminders flag)
